name: SigningAuthorityRegister
tagline: Who may sign what, for which entity, up to which amount – and until when.
description: A complete register of statutory officers, board delegations, powers of attorney and bank mandates with a can-they-sign checker, authority matrix, expiry and renewal workflow and audit-ready KPIs – one PCF control for Canvas, Model-driven and Power Pages.
features: Sole/joint signing rules with allowed class pairs
Limits with FX conversion to a base currency
POA notarisation and maximum duration rules
Phone layout with bottom view bar
react: 16.14.0 bundled (no platform libraries, no Fluent UI)
controlType: standard (SigningAuthorityRegister data-set control + SigningAuthorityRegisterPortal field control)
